items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Gene Hall, I know Gene Hall. Yeah, piano.

ctx.x: No. No, they only had the tuxedo. That's Mike DeLay. And, Gene, Gene Ware, you ever heard of him? Mm-hmm. Yeah, piano player. I don't know. Gene Ware?

Gene Hall, I know Gene Hall. Yeah, piano. Yeah, and somebody else, I forgot that was a tuxedo. Where was that? That was around in there behind, the southern station on Canal Street at that time. Used to have a station on Canal Street.
